'''Faelon's Folly''' is a part of the western coastline of [[Gillijim's Isle]]. It is the site of [[High elf|High elven]] shipwrecks that accompanied the [[Kul Tiran Exploratory Fleet]] on a secretive mission led by [[Captain Faelon]]. The entire squadron was slain by the Deeptide Naga, and they now haunt the shores.<ref>{{Alliance}} [51] [[Faelon's Folly (quest)|Faelon's Folly]]</ref>
